Name: Jason, Kinsman of Paul
Summary: Jason was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Jason of Thessalonica, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
KeyStory: Jason was a kinsman of Paul who sends greetings in Romans 16. He is listed separately from Jason of Thessalonica, since the letter does not identify them as the same man.
LifeLesson: Greetings from kinsmen show how the gospel travelled along family lines.
